2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"></path><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg></span><span>复制全文</span></button></div><h1 class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="task-management">任务与文件管理<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">随着任务越积越多，左侧边栏提供了几个高频管理能力：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">任务视图</strong> 让你按分组、工作区或时间线组织任务列表，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区文件树</strong> 让你不离开 ZCode 就能浏览文件、查看变更并把文件引用进对话，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Wiki</strong> 则把整个仓库的结构整理成一份随时可查的文档。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="task-views">任务视图<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">左侧任务栏顶部的视图菜单提供三种组织方式，可以随时切换。</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">分组</strong>：按自定义分组归类任务，适合按主题或优先级整理。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区</strong>：任务跟着项目走，每个工作区下平铺它的任务。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">时间线</strong>：按时间倒序排列，找最近做过的事最快。</li>
</ul>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/task-views-quad-card-20260611.webp" alt="视图菜单，以及分组、工作区、时间线三种视图" style="max-width:100%"/>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">视图菜单旁边还有三个常用入口：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">排序方式</strong>：在视图菜单里选择，按 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建时间</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">更新时间</strong> 排列任务。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">搜索</strong>：点击放大镜图标，可以按关键词搜索命令、会话或文件。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">归档</strong>：点击归档图标进入归档列表。已完成、无未读、未置顶且超过保留期的任务会进入自动归档候选（保留期可设 3 / 7 / 14 / 30 天）；列表里每条任务右侧有两个按钮，分别用来 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">取消归档</strong>（恢复回任务列表）和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">删除</strong>。</li>
</ul>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/task-sort-archive-card-20260611.webp" alt="排序方式、搜索与归档列表" style="max-width:100%"/>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="task-groups">任务分组<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">切换到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">分组</strong> 视图，即可按自定义分组组织任务。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="task-groups-manage">创建与管理分组<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建分组</strong>，输入分组名称</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击分组标题右侧的颜色点，可在 7 种颜色（灰 / 红 / 橙 / 黄 / 绿 / 蓝 / 紫）中选择，用颜色区分项目或优先级</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">单击分组标题可随时 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重命名</strong></li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">右键分组可选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">取消分组并删除</strong>——只删除分组本身，组内任务会保留并移出分组</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="task-groups-organize">整理任务<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">拖拽</strong>：直接把任务拖进目标分组，也可以在组内拖拽排序、拖动分组标题调整分组顺序</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">右键菜单</strong>：在任务上右键选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">移动到分组</strong> / <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">移出分组</strong>，不方便拖拽时同样高效</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">移动到顶部</strong>：组内任务较多时，右键选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">移动到顶部</strong> 比一路拖上去快得多</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">折叠与展开</strong>：点击分组标题左侧的三角形折叠单个分组，或用列表顶部按钮全部展开 / 收起</li>
</ul>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/task-group-tools-card-20260611.jpg" alt="分组颜色选择，以及空分组的新建与拖拽提示" style="max-width:608px"/>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="quick-actions">快捷入口<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">左侧栏顶部的搜索框不只用来找任务。点开后会列出 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">快捷入口</strong>：新对话、打开文件夹、搜索文件、切换主题、MCP 服务器、切换终端等常用操作都能在这里直接执行，旁边标注了对应的快捷键，熟悉之后基本不用碰鼠标。</p>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/task-quick-actions-card-20260611.jpg" alt="快捷入口：常用操作与快捷键一览" style="max-width:632px"/>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="file-tree">工作区文件树<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击工作区卡片右侧的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">文件树图标</strong>（查看文件），左侧边栏会切换为当前工作区的文件树；点击顶部 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">返回任务</strong> 即可切回任务列表。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/file-tree-overview-20260611.webp" alt="工作区文件树：浏览文件并查看 Git 状态" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="file-tree-browse">浏览与搜索<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">搜索文件</strong>：顶部搜索框支持按文件名或路径实时筛选</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仅显示变更文件</strong>：一键过滤出有 Git 变更的文件，代码评审或提交前检查特别好用</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Git 状态标识</strong>：文件右侧会显示 Git 状态标记（新增 / 修改 / 删除 / 重命名），目录上会聚合显示内部变更状态点</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="file-tree-actions">打开与引用<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">单击</strong> 文件即可在右侧打开预览；<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">双击</strong> 或按 Enter 用默认编辑器打开</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">拖拽到对话框</strong>：把文件直接拖进对话输入框，自动插入文件引用，让 Agent 围绕该文件工作</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">右键菜单</strong>：打开 / 打开方式（选择已安装的编辑器）/ <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">添加到聊天</strong> / 复制路径 / 在资源管理器中打开</li>
</ul>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/file-preview-20260611.webp" alt="单击文件在右侧打开预览" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">提示</strong>：「仅显示变更文件」+「添加到聊天」组合使用，可以快速把本次改动的文件喂给 Agent 做自查或生成提交说明。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="repo-wiki">Wiki<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">文件树顶部、仓库名称旁的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仓库 Wiki</strong> 图标，会基于当前仓库生成一份架构导读：讲清楚这个项目是干什么的、主流程怎么跑、有哪些核心模块、数据怎么流动，每个结论都能点回源码。接手陌生项目时特别有用。完整说明见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/repo-wiki">Wiki</a>。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="git-graph">Git 图谱<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">工作区顶部的分支切换器下拉里还有一个 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Git 图谱</strong> 入口，打开后是一张只读的提交历史图：分支并排画出，合并发生在哪里一目了然，适合理清「这个分支是从哪儿分出去的」「这两条线什么时候合的」。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/workbench/git-graph-annotated.webp" alt="Git 图谱：分支泳道与合并关系，右侧列出每个提交的描述、日期、作者和哈希" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击某个提交会在旁边显示它的标题、完整哈希、作者、日期和父提交。默认先加载最近的一批，点「加载更多提交」继续往前翻。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">它只负责看：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不能在图里切换分支，也不能查看具体改动内容</strong>。切换分支、新建分支在同一个下拉菜单的上半部分——如果切换时有未提交的改动，ZCode 会提示你先提交，也可以直接选择「提交并切换分支」。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
